items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1969-03-24
items.q: That was a whole band? Yeah, that was a whole band. We had, uh... We had on trumpet. Howard. Yes, Howard was on trumpet.

ctx.x: Yeah, then you went back to Denmark.

Then we went back to Denmark and we left from there and went to Baden-Baden, Germany for a week for a TV show. So, naturally, it was more of a cabaret scene. And we rehearsed that whole week. And when we finished there, we left and went back to London. And that was when, well, everything was over with. Then the boys got ready to come on. Well, Joe Rovershow, Howard, Jim, Miss Tate, George, they all left by plane. Well, Jack and I came back by boat. And that was when we run into that 80-mile gale. And I'm telling…
